verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents a public Create Campaign endpoint (create_campaign) authenticated with private API keys or OAuth. It also states that the platform is usable headlessly through its public APIs, so campaign creation without the dashboard is covered. Nothing in the pack shows an API endpoint for scheduling or sending a campaign, so only half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented campaign scheduling/send API endpoint, evidence that content/template and audience assignment can be done end-to-end via API, independent or hands-on corroboration.
